draft:
Meridian Capital today announced the completion of its acquisition of Lumen Specialty Chemicals, a leading European producer of high-purity specialty chemicals for the electronics, pharmaceutical, and advanced materials industries.

Headquartered in Frankfurt, Lumen operates three production facilities across Germany and Belgium and employs approximately 850 people. The Company supplies more than 600 customers worldwide, with particular strength in ultra-high-purity solvents used in semiconductor wafer fabrication and pharmaceutical active ingredient manufacturing.

Lumen will be led by its existing Chief Executive, Dr. Annika Brandt. Meridian intends to support an acceleration of Lumen's expansion strategy, with a focus on the Asian electronics market and on selective acquisitions in adjacent specialty chemical categories. Total invested capital from the Meridian platform in the specialty chemicals sector now exceeds EUR 2 billion across its global investments.

We expect to grow Lumen's revenue by more than 50 percent over the next five years and to deliver substantial expansion in EBITDA margins through operational improvements and selective M&A. The transaction represents the eighth investment from Meridian's European Industrials strategy.
